name: goBILDA Pinpoint
description: Driver for the goBILDA Pinpoint odometry computer. Included in the FTC SDK; no dependency is needed.

builtIn.note: See the SensorGoBildaPinpoint sample in FtcRobotController. SDK 11.1 added Pinpoint v2 support.

verification.notes: GoBildaPinpointDriver is present in org.firstinspires.ftc:Hardware 11.0.0 and 12.0.0; the SDK release notes list Pinpoint support as added in 10.3 and Pinpoint v2 support in 11.1.
